records.statement: Circle lists 22 local stablecoins as active or onboarding to StableFX. This does not mean all 22 are live in production or have measurable route volume.

JPYC appears in Circle's 22-currency StableFX list; SBI Shinsei Trust Bank's JPYSC does not. Circle's statement that SBI will leverage USDC and JPYSC in its APAC collaboration does not establish a live JPYSC StableFX route or on-Arc transfer.

Coinbase, Binance and Upbit are listed as exchange-access partners, while SBI Group is in the founding validator cohort. Do not describe Coinbase as an Arc validator or infer that every named builder operates a validator.
Aave V3 Horizon's $86M RLUSD supplied and 94.1% utilization describe a reserve supply/utilization snapshot, not $86M of RLUSD collateral posted by borrowers and not XRP activity.

The Aave V4 Arc table labels $109M as 'Added' and reports 100% utilization. It is not a disclosed current collateral balance, not a token-level XRP reserve, and not a current live balance at this run's cutoff.

LTV 0/collateral factor 0 prevents the named assets from adding new borrowing power. It is not equivalent to a continuing market freeze; the governance update says supplying, withdrawing, borrowing and repaying work normally and existing V3 positions retain liquidation thresholds.

Binance's official PoR page exposes a Download All Address control, but the dynamic target URL was not available in the retrieved page. No address export was downloaded and no five-wallet XRP crosswalk is established.

Alpha Finance, XRP Insights and CryptoETF.today use different fund universes, units, settlement states and XRP reference prices for October 29. Their flows must not be averaged or converted without a common fund-level holdings series.

CoinGlass, Coinalyze and TradRadar open-interest totals use different/unclear venue and contract universes and timestamps. Coinalyze explicitly includes only XRP/USD, XRP/USDT and XRP/USDC and says its chart is not real-time. Do not average provider totals.

Binance.US reports its own XRP/USD quote and separately sources some market statistics from CoinMarketCap. A single venue quote is not a consolidated global reference price and its live page does not provide a stable historical cutoff.

Binance's $6.34B company reserve, $5B already held in exact impacted token assets and remaining market/OTC acquisition plan are aggregate. No XRP-specific amount, venue, execution or price impact is disclosed.

Circle's Arc launch and StableFX announcement do not report XRP integration, XRP collateral, XRP bridge usage or displacement of XRP payment volume. Strategic competition is a hypothesis, not an observed flow.

The October 30 equity selloff is a plausible risk-off confounder, but no synchronized XRP/BTC/ETH/FX/rates event study was run. Do not attribute the XRP move solely to the Binance incident or macro factors.
No fixed-horizon walk-forward model, calibration test, synchronized feature panel or shadow forecast outcome was completed in this run. Directional forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.
